description_en: Adds one or more inbound rules to a security group. This operation allows you to specify inbound access permissions for a security group to allow or deny inbound traffic from other devices to instances in the security group, which implements fine-grained network access control
description_zh: 本接口是阿里云 ECS 中用于增加一条或多条安全组入方向规则的接口。通过该接口，用户可以指定安全组入方向的访问权限，允许或者拒绝其他设备发送入方向流量到安全组内的实例，从而实现对网络访问的精细控制
name: AuthorizeSecurityGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the security group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
parameters.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The description of the security group rule. The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 安全组规则的描述信息。长度为1~512个字符
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The destination IPv4 CIDR block. Both CIDR format and IPv4 format address ranges are supported.

This parameter is used to support quintuple rules. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html
fields.help_zh:
目的端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。

用于支持五元组规则，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html
fields.name: dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The network layer or transport layer protocol. Two types of values are supported:
Case-insensitive protocol names. Valid values:
ICMP
GRE
TCP
UDP
ALL: all protocols.
IANA-standard protocol numbers, which are integers from 0 to 255. This is available in the following regions:
Philippines
UK
Malaysia
China (Hohhot)
China (Qingdao)
US (Silicon Valley)
Singapore
fields.help_zh:
网络层/传输层协议。支持两类赋值：
不区分大小写的协议名。取值范围：
ICMP
GRE
TCP
UDP
ALL：支持所有协议。
符合IANA规范的协议号取值，即0 到 255的整数。目前开放的地域列表：
菲律宾
英国
马来西亚
呼和浩特
青岛
美西
新加坡
fields.name: ip_protocol

fields.help_en:
The destination IPv6 CIDR block. Both CIDR format and IPv6 format address ranges are supported.

This parameter is used to support quintuple rules. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html.

This parameter is valid only for VPC-type ECS instances that support IPv6. You cannot specify both this parameter and the DestCidrIp parameter in the same settings
fields.help_zh:
目的端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。

用于支持五元组规则，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html。

仅在支持IPv6的VPC类型ECS实例上有效，且该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置
fields.name: ipv6_dest_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block for access permission settings. Both CIDR format and IPv6 format address ranges are supported.

This parameter is valid only for VPC-type ECS instances that support IPv6. You cannot specify both this parameter and the SourceCidrIp parameter in the same settings
fields.help_zh:
需要设置访问权限的源端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。

仅在支持IPv6的VPC类型ECS实例上有效，且该参数与`SourceCidrIp`参数不可同时设置
fields.name: ipv6_source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The NIC type for security group rules in the classic network. Valid values:

internet: public NIC.

intranet: internal NIC.

No NIC type settings are required for security group rules in a VPC. The default value is intranet, and it can only be set to intranet.

When you configure mutual access between security groups, which means only the DestGroupId parameter is specified, this parameter can only be set to intranet.

Default value: internet
fields.help_zh:
经典网络类型安全组规则的网卡类型。取值范围：

internet：公网网卡。

intranet：内网网卡。

专有网络VPC类型安全组规则无需设置网卡类型，默认为intranet，只能为intranet。

设置安全组之间互相访问时，即仅指定了DestGroupId参数时，只能为intranet。

默认值：internet
fields.name: nic_type

fields.help_en:
The access permission settings. Valid values:

accept: allows access.

drop: denies access without returning a rejection message. The initiator experiences a request timeout or a connection failure.

Default value: accept
fields.help_zh:
设置访问权限。取值范围：

accept：接受访问。

drop：拒绝访问，不返回拒绝信息，表现为发起端请求超时或者无法建立连接的类似信息。

默认值：accept
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en:
The destination port range for the specified protocol opened in the security group. Valid values:

TCP or UDP: 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the stop port. Example: 1/200.
ICMP: -1/-1.
GRE: -1/-1.
ALL: -1/-1.

For more information about common scenarios, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40724.html
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的目的端口范围。取值范围：

TCP/UDP：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP：-1/-1。
GRE：-1/-1。
IpProtocol取值为ALL：-1/-1。

了解端口的应用场景，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40724.html
fields.name: port_range

fields.help_en:
The ID of the port list.
You can call the DescribePortRangeLists operation to query available port list IDs.
If you specify the Permissions.N.PortRange parameter, this parameter is ignored.
Port lists are not supported when the network type of the security group is classic network. For more information about the limits on security groups and port lists, see [Security group limits](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
fields.help_zh:
端口列表 ID。
您可以调用`DescribePortRangeLists`查询可以使用的端口列表 ID。
当您指定了`Permissions.N.PortRange`参数时，将忽略该参数。
安全组的网络类型为经典网络时，不支持设置端口列表。关于安全组以及端口列表使用限制的更多信息，请参见[安全组使用限制](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
fields.name: port_range_list_id

fields.help_en:
The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
安全组规则优先级，数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1~100。

默认值：1
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The source IPv4 CIDR block for access permission settings. Both CIDR format and IPv4 format address ranges are supported
fields.help_zh: 需要设置访问权限的源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围
fields.name: source_cidr_ip

fields.help_en:
The ID of the source security group for access permission settings.

You must specify at least one of the following parameters: SourceGroupId, SourceCidrIp, Ipv6SourceCidrIp, and SourcePrefixListId.

If you specify SourceGroupId but do not specify SourceCidrIp or Ipv6SourceCidrIp, you must set NicType to intranet.

If you specify both SourceGroupId and SourceCidrIp, SourceCidrIp takes precedence by default
fields.help_zh:
需要设置访问权限的源端安全组ID。

至少设置`SourceGroupId`、`SourceCidrIp`、`Ipv6SourceCidrIp`或`SourcePrefixListId`参数中的一项。

如果指定了`SourceGroupId`，没有指定参数`SourceCidrIp`或`Ipv6SourceCidrIp`，则参数`NicType`取值只能为`intranet`。

如果同时指定了`SourceGroupId`和`SourceCidrIp`，则默认以`SourceCidrIp`为准
fields.name: source_group_id

fields.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account that owns the source security group for cross-account security group rule settings.

If neither SourceGroupOwnerAccount nor SourceGroupOwnerId is specified, the rule applies to the access permission settings for your other security groups.

If SourceCidrIp is specified, the SourceGroupOwnerAccount parameter is invalid
fields.help_zh:
跨账户设置安全组规则时，源端安全组所属的阿里云账户。

如果`SourceGroupOwnerAccount`及`SourceGroupOwnerId`均未设置，则认为是设置您其他安全组的访问权限。

如果已经设置参数`SourceCidrIp`，则参数`SourceGroupOwnerAccount`无效
fields.name: source_group_owner_account

fields.help_en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the source security group for cross-account security group rule settings.

If neither SourceGroupOwnerAccount nor SourceGroupOwnerId is specified, the rule applies to the access permission settings for your other security groups.

If SourceCidrIp is specified, the SourceGroupOwnerAccount parameter is invalid
fields.help_zh:
跨账户设置安全组规则时，源端安全组所属的阿里云账户ID。

如果`SourceGroupOwnerAccount`及`SourceGroupOwnerId`均未设置，则认为是设置您其他安全组的访问权限。

如果已经设置参数`SourceCidrIp`，则参数`SourceGroupOwnerAccount`无效
fields.name: source_group_owner_id

fields.help_en:
The source port range for the specified protocol. Valid values:

TCP or UDP: 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port and the end port. Example: 1/200.
ICMP: -1/-1.
GRE: -1/-1.
ALL: -1/-1.

This parameter is used to support quintuple rules. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html
fields.help_zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的源端端口范围。取值范围：

TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
GRE协议：-1/-1。
IpProtocol取值为ALL：-1/-1。

用于支持五元组规则，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97439.html
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en:
The ID of the source prefix list for access permission settings. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205046.html operation to query available prefix list IDs.

Precautions:

If you specify SourceCidrIp, Ipv6SourceCidrIp, or SourceGroupId, this parameter is ignored.

For more information, see [Security group limits](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
fields.help_zh:
需要设置访问权限的源端前缀列表ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/205046.html查询可以使用的前缀列表ID。

注意事项：

当您指定了`SourceCidrIp`、`Ipv6SourceCidrIp`或`SourceGroupId`参数中的一个时，将忽略该参数。

更多信息，请参见[安全组使用限制](~~25412#SecurityGroupQuota1~~)
fields.name: source_prefix_list_id
